empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a Markdown document or an archive.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a Markdown document or an archive. Nothing is stored until you confirm.

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.
file.fileHint: A Markdown document or an archive. Nothing in the file is written to disk or executed.
file.unsupported: Only a Markdown document (.md) or an archive (.zip) can be imported.
file.nothingStored: Nothing has been stored yet — this is only what the file proposes.
file.ignoredHint: Listed only — nothing in these entries was read, executed or stored.
file.disabledNotice: On confirm the skill is stored disabled and marked as coming from an untrusted source. It reaches no agent until you vet it and enable it.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

listItem.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? This cannot be undone.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

editor.title: Configuration
editor.name: Name
editor.descriptionCaption: The description is the skill's interface — what it is for and when it applies. A selector reads this, not the body, to decide whether the skill belongs in a review.
editor.bodyHint: This text is what reaches the model, in the position the agent gives it.

agentTab.none: No skills attached. Attach one below to put it in this agent's prompt.
agentTab.noneAvailable: No skills in this workspace yet.
agentTab.disabledHint: Disabled workspace-wide — attached here, but sent to no model.
